List of Pokémon by index number in Generation VII

  • Italiano
  • 中文

In each Pokémon game of Generation VII, all Pokémon have an unseen index number used to identify them in the game's ROM. All of them are in their National Pokédex order. Numbers 803 to 807 were added in Pokémon Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon and are not present in Pokémon Sun and Moon. Only numbers 1 to 151, 808, and 809 are present in Pokémon: Let's Go, Pikachu! and Let's Go, Eevee!, though some unused data carried over from Pokémon Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon is present for numbers 152 to 807.
